answer: Run a sampling audit every epoch and reset the score to zero the moment an identity tries to link to another one it controls, since that link is the trick behind a fake fleet. Because no identity may audit its own recruit, the reset also kills the easy recovery path, so a farm loses its grove of scores and has to rebuild on a terrace it no longer owns. Blunt version: one careless link costs a year of standing, and the jetty of stored evidence is what makes it stick.
